problem_name: University Course Timetable Scheduling (CSP & Local Search Optimization)

hard_constraints.name: No Room Double-Booking
hard_constraints.description: A single room cannot host more than one course session simultaneously at the same time slot.

hard_constraints.name: Room Capacity & Capability
hard_constraints.description: Room capacity must be greater than or equal to course enrollment, and room type must match required type (e.g., Computer Lab for lab courses).

hard_constraints.name: No Instructor Double-Booking
hard_constraints.description: An instructor cannot teach more than one course session at the same time slot.

hard_constraints.name: Instructor Unavailability
hard_constraints.description: An instructor cannot be scheduled into their declared unavailable time slots.

hard_constraints.name: No Student Cohort Clash
hard_constraints.description: Mandatory courses belonging to the same student cohort cannot be scheduled at the same time slot.

hard_constraints.name: Complete Course Scheduling
hard_constraints.description: Every required course in the curriculum must be assigned to a valid slot and room.

soft_constraints.name: Instructor Preferred Slots
soft_constraints.description: Prefer assigning instructors to their preferred time slots.

soft_constraints.name: Room Capacity Optimization
soft_constraints.description: Avoid assigning small classes to oversized rooms to minimize wasted seat capacity (penalty for excess unused capacity > 30 seats).

soft_constraints.name: Minimize Student Cohort Dead Hours
soft_constraints.description: Avoid fragmented schedules with isolated idle gaps (e.g. 1-slot gaps) between classes on the same day for student cohorts.

soft_constraints.name: Consecutive Session Fatigue Limit
soft_constraints.description: Penalize having more than 2 consecutive sessions back-to-back without a break for the same cohort or instructor.

soft_constraints.name: Minimize Cross-Building Rushing
soft_constraints.description: Penalize consecutive sessions for the same student cohort in different campus buildings.
